subject: Maths
title: Finding percentages of amounts
subtitle: Decimals and Percentages · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can calculate a percentage of a given amount using mental and written methods.

key_vocab.definition: Finding a percentage of an amount means finding that fraction of the total. 'Of' means multiply.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can calculate a percentage of a given amount using mental and written methods.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: percentage of an amount -- Finding a percentage of an amount means finding that fraction of the total. 'Of' means multiply.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
To find x% of an amount: divide by 100, multiply by x. Or use 10% building blocks.
x% of A = A × x ÷ 100
Percentage means per hundred

Key examples:
  ✓ 50% of 80 = 40  (half)
  ✓ 10% of 250 = 25  (÷ 10)
  ✓ 25% of 60 = 15  (÷ 4)
  ✗ 10% of 80 = 8.0 (move 2 places)  (only move 1 place)
  ✗ 30% of 50 = 30 × 50 = 1500  (must divide by 100 too)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – simple percentage
  Find 20% of £150.
  10% of 150 = 15
  20% = 2 × 10% = 2 × 15
  = £30
  = £30
  (Find 10% first, then double it.)

Example 2 – using division
  Find 35% of 200.
  200 ÷ 100 = 2 (this is 1%)
  2 × 35 = 70
  35% of 200 = 70
  = 70
  (Divide by 100 to get 1%, then multiply.)

sections.title: Simple percentages
sections.content:
Find each percentage.

(a) 50% of 60
(b) 25% of 80
(c) 10% of 350
(d) 75% of 40

sections.title: Using 10% building blocks
sections.content:
Find each percentage of the amount.

(a) 20% of 90
(b) 30% of 150
(c) 40% of 200
(d) 60% of 250

sections.title: Trickier percentages
sections.content:
Use 10% and 5% building blocks.

(a) 15% of 120
(b) 35% of 200
(c) 45% of 80
(d) 5% of 360

sections.title: Word problems
sections.content:
Calculate each amount.

(a) 20% discount on £55
(b) 15% tip on a £40 meal
(c) VAT is 20% on £250
(d) 65% of 120 students passed

sections.title: Mixed
sections.content:
Find each percentage.

(a) 12% of 300
(b) 85% of 60
(c) 2.5% of 400
(d) 17.5% of 200
(e) 33&frac{1}{3}% of 90

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ 10% means divide by 10
✗ 50% of 70 = 140
✓ 25% is the same as &frac{1}{4}
✗ To find 1%, divide by 10
✓ 15% = 10% + 5%
